description: This is a Python module for database access related to product management. It includes functions to create, retrieve, update, delete, and list products using the Supabase client, with helper functions for external service interaction and querying.

methods.name: Client get_supabase_client()
methods.description: Creates and returns a Supabase client configured with settings, for server-side operations.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] products_list( sb: Optional[Client] = None, limit: int = 100, offset: int = 0, search: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Retrieves a list of products with optional search, pagination, and default limit.

methods.name: Optional[Dict[str,Any]] products_get(product_id: str, sb: Optional[Client] = None)
methods.description: Fetches a single product by its ID.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] products_create( payload: Dict[str, Any], sb: Optional[Client] = None )
methods.description: Inserts a new product record into the database.

methods.name: Optional[Dict[str,Any]] products_update( product_id: str, payload: Dict[str, Any], sb: Optional[Client] = None )
methods.description: Updates an existing product identified by ID with provided payload.

methods.name: bool products_delete(product_id: str, sb: Optional[Client] = None)
methods.description: Deletes a product by ID, returning True if deletion was successful.
